items.issue: The upload is an edited and reordered derivative of formal source S-cMTEvo6To: 43.42% 12-character shingle containment and 84.98% normalized sequence match.

items.issue: Identifiable-person marriage, motive, business and financial allegations are repeated without independent evidence.
items.disposition: Keep as attributed allegations only and do not use for factual or legal conclusions.

items.issue: Some passages endorse insulting a woman, showing displeasure, creating social discomfort, and maintaining relationship leverage through replaceability.
items.disposition: Do not turn into action advice; preserve consent, non-coercion, respectful boundary-setting and freedom to leave.

items.issue: Claims about women, ethnic groups, criminals, body shape, hunting ability and reproductive fitness are broad unsupported generalizations.
items.disposition: Keep do_not_generalize and do not use as biological, racial or social fact.

items.issue: The love-versus-logical-liking model is presented as if it reveals another person's true motives.
items.disposition: Treat as Mikey's definition; do not diagnose a partner from wealth, appearance, stated reasons or a single behavior.

items.issue: Father/child/dog analogies imply that mistreatment is largely produced by how the target behaves, creating victim-blaming risk.
items.disposition: Do not infer responsibility for abuse or exploitation from these analogies.

items.issue: Personal sexual, dating and partner-apology anecdotes are self-reported and the underlying messages or participants are not shown.
items.disposition: Keep as unverified self-report and close first-person reuse permission.
